description: Which master pushes run the C-query worker on macOS and Windows (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job nir1-c-query-worker). A push that changes none of these paths skips those two legs (Linux still runs); the nightly run and the release call cover them. Anything unclassified, empty, incomplete or unresolvable runs them. The unit is the crate: the worker links all of grimodex-db, which links grimodex-core, so any file of either can break only macOS or Windows. The external files are those the two crates include or address by a ../ path (include_str!, include_bytes!, CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR); scripts/ci-cross-os-scope.test.mjs derives them and fails when one is missing here.
